svg.text: 261 nodes · 331 relationships · 206 implied labels, generated from the OASIS Akoma Ntoso Version 1.0 XML schema (akomantoso30.xsd). The main arrows are named by their relationship type; hover any arrow for its name and description, and cards link to the element's page in the Akoma Ntoso specification.
Metadata: identification, lifecycle, analysis and references
Structure: hierarchy, preambles, debates, judgments and amendments
References: top-level classes, document references and inline elements
composition: element to the elements it contains
reference: an attribute to the element whose eId it gives
subtype: also carries the supertype's label

AS: The attribute role is used to identify the role of an individual mentioned in the text. It is a reference to a TLCRole element in the references section. Resolves the as attribute of the DebateContainer, # followed by an eId, to the TLCRole it identifies. Each DebateContainer refers to at most one TLCRole.

BY: The attribute by is used to identify the agent of an action. It is a reference to a TLCPerson or TLCOrganization element in the references section. Resolves the by attribute of the DebateContainer, # followed by an eId, to the Agent it identifies. Each DebateContainer refers to exactly one Agent.

TO: The attributes in speechAtts are used in speeches to identify agents and roles of speeches. In particular, attribute 'by' identifies the speaker, optional attribute 'as' identifies the role under which the speaker is speaking, optional attribute startTime specifies the absolute date and time where the individual speech item started, optional attribute endTime specifies the absolute date and time where the individual speech item ended, and optional attribute to identifies the addressee of the speech. All of them are references to person or organization elements in the references section. Resolves the to attribute of the DebateContainer, # followed by an eId, to the Agent it identifies. Each DebateContainer refers to at most one Agent.

EMPOWERED_BY: The attributes in lawyerAtts are used in the inline element lawyer to identify representation aspects of lawyers. Resolves the empoweredBy attribute of the Lawyer, # followed by an eId, to the Agent it identifies. Each Lawyer refers to at most one Agent.

Every TLCEvent is also a TLC
Every TLCLocation is also a TLC

Every TLCPerson is also a Agent

Every TLCReference is also a TLC

g.title: Act — Element act is used for describing the structure and content of an act. Properties: uri, name, contains
ActiveModifications — The element activeModifications is a metadata container of the active modifications generated by the document. Properties: uri
ActiveRef — The element activeRef is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of a document that is modified by this document (i.e., an active references). Properties: uri
Address — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that are relevant to addresses. Properties: uri
Adjournment — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that contain adjournment notices. Properties: uri
AdministrationOfOath — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that contain the administration of an oath. Properties: uri
AffectedDocument — The element affectedDocument is an inline element within preamble to identify the document that this amendment affects. Properties: uri, href

Agent — An agent: a person or an organization of the references section, which the attributes typed agentRef, e.g. by, source, to and empoweredBy, refer to. A label carried by TLCOrganization and TLCPerson. Properties: uri

AkomaNtoso — NAME akomaNtoso the element akomaNtoso is the root element of all document types in Akoma Ntoso. It follows the pattern Universal Root (http://www.xmlpatterns.com/UniversalRootMain.shtml). Properties: uri
Alinea — This element is a hierarchical container called "alinea" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri

AlternativeReference — The element alternativeReference contains an alternative reference (e.g., using a different namespace) for a legal reference. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, for, refersTo, showAs, shortForm
Amendment — Element amendment is used for describing the structure and content of an amendment. Properties: uri, name, contains

AmendmentBlock — The group amendmentBlock lists the structures that should be found in an amendment. A label carried by AmendmentContent, AmendmentHeading, AmendmentJustification and AmendmentReference. Properties: uri
AmendmentBody — The element amendmentBody is the container of the main hierarchy of a amendment document. Properties: uri
AmendmentContent — This element is a structural container for the section of an amendment containing the actual amendment text. Properties: uri
AmendmentHeading — This element is a structural container for the section of an amendment containing the heading. Properties: uri

AmendmentInline — The group amendmentInline lists the inline elements that should be found in the preface of an amendment. A label carried by AffectedDocument, Change and RelatedDocument. Properties: uri
AmendmentJustification — This element is a structural container for the section of an amendment containing the justification. Properties: uri
AmendmentList — Element amendmentList is used for describing the structure and content of a collection of amendments. Properties: uri, name, contains
AmendmentReference — This element is a structural container for the section of an amendment containing the reference. Properties: uri
Analysis — The analysis element of an Akoma Ntoso document. Properties: uri, source
Answer — The element answer is a container of a single official answer to a question. Properties: uri
Application — The element application is a metadata element specifying the period of the application modification. Properties: uri
Applies — The element applies is a metadata element specifying a reference to a source applyed by the argument being described. Properties: uri
Argument — The element argument is an inline element within judgments for classifying the arguments in the motivation part of the judgment. Properties: uri
Arguments — This element is a structural container for the section of a judgment containing the arguments. Properties: uri
Article — This element is a hierarchical container called "article" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Attachment — The element attachment is used as a container of individual attachment elements. Properties: uri, num, heading, subheading
AttachmentOf — The element attachmentOf is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of a document of which this document is an attachment. Properties: uri, type
Attachments — The attachments element of an Akoma Ntoso document. Properties: uri
AuthorialNote — The element authorialNote is a subFlow element containing an authorial (non-editorial) note in the main flow of the text. Properties: uri, marker, placement, placementBase
Background — This element is a structural container for the section of a judgment containing the background. Properties: uri
Bill — Element bill is used for describing the structure and content of a bill. Properties: uri, name, contains
Body — The element body is the container of the main hierarchy of a hierarchical document (e.g, an act or a bill). Properties: uri
Book — This element is a hierarchical container called "book" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Change — The element change is an inline element that identifies the changes expressed in the two columns of an amendment document. Properties: uri
Chapter — This element is a hierarchical container called "chapter" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Citation — The element citation is the individual element of the preface that is called citation. Properties: uri, num, heading, subheading
Citations — The element citations is the section of the preamble that contains citations. Properties: uri, num, heading, subheading
Classification — The classification element of an Akoma Ntoso document. Properties: uri, source
Clause — This element is a hierarchical container called "clause" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri

CollectionBody — The element collectionBody is the container of a list of other documents (e.g, acts, bills, amendments, etc.) possibly interspersed with interstitial elements with content that does not form an individual document. Properties: uri
Communication — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that contain communications from the house. Properties: uri
Component — The element component is a container of a subdocument specified in a composite document. Properties: uri, num, heading, subheading

ComponentRef — The element componentRef is a reference to a separate manifestation-level resource that holds the content of the component of the document not physically placed at the position specified. Actual resources can either be external (e.g. in the package or even in a different position) or internal (within the components element). Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, src, alt, showAs, shortForm
Components — The components element of an Akoma Ntoso document. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid
Concept — The element concept is is an inline element to identify a text fragment introducing or referring to a concept in the ontology. Properties: uri, refersTo
Conclusions — The element conclusion is used as a container of all concluding material (e.g. dates, signatures, formulas, etc.). Properties: uri
Condition — The element condition is a metadata element specifying an open set of conditions on the modification (non managed by Akoma Ntoso). Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, frozen
Content — The element content is the final container in a hierarchy, and is where the blocks of text of the content of the structure are finally specified. Properties: uri

ContentElement — An element of a document's content, which has the core attributes all such elements have: its identifiers (eId, wId and GUID), the elements of the references section it refers to (refersTo), the time interval it is in force or in efficacy (period), its status, its language and the element it is an alternative to. Properties: uri, period, status, eId, wId, guid, refersTo, lang, alternativeTo
Contrasts — The element contrasts is a metadata element specifying a reference to a source contrasted by the argument being described. Properties: uri
Count — The element count is a metadata container containing the value of a count in a vote or a quorum verification. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, value, refersTo, href
CourtType — The element courtType is an inline element within judgments to identify the string used by the document for the type of the court doing the judgment. Properties: uri
CoverPage — The element coverPage is used as a container of the text that acts as a cover page. Properties: uri
Date — The element date is an inline element to identify a date expressed in the text and to propose a normalized representation in the date attribute. Properties: uri, date
Debate — Element debate is used for describing the structure and content of a debate record. Properties: uri, name, contains
DebateBody — The element debateBody is the container of the main hierarchy of a debate. Properties: uri

DebateContainer — The group ANcontainers lists the elements that are containers and are specific to the Akoma Ntoso debate vocabulary. A label carried by Answer, Question, Speech and SpeechGroup. Properties: uri, by, as, startTime, endTime, to, num, heading, subheading
DebateReport — Element debateReport is used for describing the structure and content of a report. Properties: uri, name, contains
DebateSection — This element is a generic structural container for all other parts of a debates that are not explicitly supported with a named element. Properties: uri, name
Decision — This element is a structural container for the section of a judgment containing the decision. Properties: uri
DeclarationOfVote — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that are relevant to the declaration of votes. Properties: uri
Def — The element def is an inline element used for the definition of a term used in the rest of the document. Properties: uri
Derogates — The element derogates is a metadata element specifying a reference to a source derogated by the argument being described. Properties: uri
Destination — The element destination is a metadata element specifying the IRI of the destination of the modification. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, pos, exclusion, incomplete, upTo
DissentsFrom — The element dissentsFrom is a metadata element specifying a reference to a source dissented from the argument being described. Properties: uri
Distinguishes — The element distinguishes is a metadata element specifying a reference to a source being distinguished by the argument being described. Properties: uri
Division — This element is a hierarchical container called "division" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri

Doc — Element doc is used for describing the structure and content of any other document that is not included in the list of document explicitly managed by Akoma Ntoso. Properties: uri, name, contains
DocAuthority — The element docAuthority is an inline element within preface to identify the string used by the document detailing the Auhtority to which the document was submitted. Properties: uri

DocCommittee — The element docCommittee is an inline element within preface to identify the string used by the document detailing the committee within which the document originated. Properties: uri, value

DocDate — The element docDate is an inline element within preface to identify the string used by the document for its own date(s). Documents with multiple dates may use multiple docDate elements. Properties: uri, date
DocIntroducer — The element docIntroducer is an inline element within preface to identify the string used by the document detailing the individual introducing of the document. Properties: uri
DocJurisdiction — The element docJurisdiction is an inline element within preface to identify the string used by the document detailing the jurisdiction of the document. Properties: uri
DocNumber — The element docNumber is an inline element within preface to identify the string used by the document for its own number. Properties: uri
DocProponent — The element docProponent is an inline element within preface to identify the string used by the document for its proponent. Properties: uri, as
DocPurpose — The element docPurpose is an inline element within preface to identify the string used by the document detailing its own purpose. Properties: uri
DocRef — The group docrefs is a list of types of legal references to documents. A label carried by ActiveRef, AttachmentOf, HasAttachment, Jurisprudence, Original and PassiveRef. Properties: uri
DocStage — The element docStage is an inline element within preface to identify the string used by the document detailing the stage in which the document sits. Properties: uri
DocStatus — The element docStatus is an inline element within preface to identify the string used by the document detailing the status of the document. Properties: uri
DocTitle — The element docTitle is an inline element within preface to identify the string used by the document for its own title. Properties: uri
DocType — The element docType is an inline element within preface to identify the string used by the document for its own type. Properties: uri

DocketNumber — The element docketNumber is an inline element within preface to identify the string used by the document for the number of the docket, case, file, etc which the document belongs to. Properties: uri

Document — The type documentType lists all the document types that are managed by Akoma Ntoso. A label carried by Act, Amendment, AmendmentList, Bill, Debate, DebateReport, Doc, DocumentCollection, Judgment, OfficialGazette, Portion and Statement. Properties: uri

DocumentCollection — Element documentCollection is used for describing the structure and content of a collection of other documents chosen and combined for any reason whatsoever. Properties: uri, name, contains

DocumentRef — The element documentRef is a reference to a separate work- or expression-level resource that should be placed in this position. Actual resources are external (e.g. in the package or even in a different position) and are (an expression or any expression of) a separate Work. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, showAs, shortForm
Domain — The element domain is a metadata element containing (in some non-managed form) the domain to which the modification applies. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href
Duration — The element duration is a metadata element specifying the period of the duration modification. Properties: uri
Efficacy — The element efficacy is a metadata element specifying the period of the efficacy modification. Properties: uri
EfficacyMod — The element efficacyMod is a metadata element specifying an (active or passive) modification in efficacy for the document. Properties: uri, type
Entity — The element entity is a generic inline element to identify a text fragment introducing or referring to a concept in the ontology. Properties: uri, refersTo, name
Event — The element event is an inline element to identify a text fragment introducing or referring to an event in the ontology. Properties: uri, refersTo

EventRef — The element eventRef is a metadata element specifying facts about an event that had an effect on the document. For each event, a date, a type and a document that generated the event must be referenced. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, date, source, refersTo, type, originatingExpression
Extends — The element extends is a metadata element specifying a reference to a source extended by the argument being described. Properties: uri

FRBRAuthor — The element FRBRauthor is the metadata property containing a relevant author of the document in the respective level of the FRBR hierarchy. Attribute as specifies the role of the author. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, as

FRBRExpression — The element FRBRExpression is the metadata container of identifying properties related to the Expression level according to the FRBR hierarchy. Properties: uri, frbrVersionNumber, frbrAuthoritative, frbrMasterExpression, frbrLanguage
FRBRItem — The element FRBRItem is the metadata container of identifying properties related to the Item level according to the FRBR hierarchy. Properties: uri

FRBRLevel — The complexType coreProperties lists the identifying properties available at any of the FRBR hierarchy levels. A label carried by FRBRExpression, FRBRItem, FRBRManifestation and FRBRWork. Properties: uri, frbrThis, frbrUri, frbrAlias, frbrAliasName, frbrDate, frbrDateName
FRBRManifestation — The element FRBRManifestation is the metadata container of identifying properties related to the Manifestation level according to the FRBR hierarchy. Properties: uri, frbrFormat

FRBRTranslation — The element FRBRtranslation is the metadata property specifying the source of which this expression is a translation of. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, fromLanguage, authoritative, pivot, by

FRBRWork — The element FRBRWork is the metadata container of identifying properties related to the Work level according to the FRBR hierarchy. Properties: uri, frbrCountry, frbrSubtype, frbrNumber, frbrName, frbrPrescriptive, frbrAuthoritative
Force — The element force is a metadata element specifying the period of the force modification. Properties: uri
ForceMod — The element forceMod is a metadata element specifying an (active or passive) modification in force for the document. Properties: uri, type

Formula — The element formula is a section of the preface or preamble that contains a formulaic expression that is systematically or frequently present in a preface or a preamble and has e precise legal meaning (e.g. an enacting formula). Use the refersTo attribute for the specification of the actual type of formula. Properties: uri, name
HasAttachment — The element hasAttachment is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of an attachment of this document. Properties: uri, type

Hcontainer — The element hcontainer is a generic element for a hierarchical container. It can be placed in a hierarchy instead of any of the other hierarchical containers. The attribute name is required and gives a name to the element. Properties: uri, name
Header — The element header is used as a container of all prefacing material of judgments (e.g. headers, formulas, etc.). Properties: uri

HeaderInline — The group ANheaderInline lists the elements that are inline, are specific to the Akoma Ntoso vocabulary, and should only be used within the header element. A label carried by Argument, CourtType, Judge, Lawyer, NeutralCitation, Party and Signature. Properties: uri

Hierarchy — The group hierElements lists all the elements that are hierarchical. A label carried by Alinea, Article, Book, Chapter, Clause, Division, Hcontainer, Indent, Level, List, Paragraph, Part, Point, Proviso, Rule, Section, Subchapter, Subclause, Subdivision, Sublist, Subparagraph, Subpart, Subrule, Subsection, Subtitle, Title, Tome and Transitional. Properties: uri, num, heading, subheading
Identification — The identification element of an Akoma Ntoso document. Properties: uri, source

ImplicitReference — The element implicitReference contains a legal reference to a document that is not explicitly mentioned in the content of the document. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, for, refersTo, showAs, shortForm
Indent — This element is a hierarchical container called "indent" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri

InlineElement — The group inlineCM is the content model of blocks and inlines, and is composed of all the inlines and all the markers. A label carried by AffectedDocument, Argument, AuthorialNote, Change, Concept, CourtType, Date, Def, DocAuthority, DocCommittee, DocDate, DocIntroducer, DocJurisdiction, DocNumber, DocProponent, DocPurpose, DocStage, DocStatus, DocTitle, DocType, DocketNumber, Entity, Event, Judge, Lawyer, Legislature, Location, Mmod, Mod, Mref, NeutralCitation, NoteRef, Object, Opinion, Organization, Party, Person, Process, Quantity, Ref, RelatedDocument, Rmod, Role, Rref, Session, ShortTitle, Signature, Term, Time and Vote. Properties: uri
Intro — The element intro is a heading element in a hierarchy that contains paragraphs introducing one or more lower hierarchical elements. Properties: uri
Introduction — This element is a structural container for the section of a judgment containing introductory material. Properties: uri
IsAnalogTo — The element isAnalogTo is a metadata element specifying a reference to a source analog to the argument being described. Properties: uri
Judge — The element judge is an inline element within judgments to identify where the document defines one of the judges, and his/her role. Properties: uri, refersTo, as
Judgment — Element judgment is used for describing the structure and content of a judgment. Properties: uri, name, contains

JudgmentBlock — The group judgmentBlock lists the structures that should be found in a judgment. A label carried by Arguments, Background, Decision, Introduction, Motivation and Remedies. Properties: uri
JudgmentBody — The element judgmentBody is the container of the main hierarchy of a judgment document. Properties: uri
Judicial — The element judicial is a metadata container of the analysis of the judicial arguments of a judgment. Properties: uri

JudicialArgument — The complex type judicialArgumentType lists all the properties associated to judicial elements. A label carried by Applies, Contrasts, Derogates, DissentsFrom, Distinguishes, Extends, IsAnalogTo, Overrules, PutsInQuestion, Restricts and Supports. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, period, status, exclusion, incomplete, refersTo
Jurisprudence — The element jurisprudence is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of a document providing jurisprudence on this document. Properties: uri

Keyword — The element keyword is a metadata element specifying a keyword associated to the FRBR expression of the document. Attribute dictionary (required) specifies the thesaurus out of which the keyword has been taken. Attribute href points to the fragment of text this keyword is associated to. Keywords without href attribute refer to the content as a whole. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, value, showAs, shortForm, refersTo, dictionary

Lawyer — The element lawyer is an inline element within judgments to identify where the document defines one of the lawyers, his/her role, which party it represents, and the other lawyer, if any, this lawyer received the power delegation of power in some role. Properties: uri, refersTo, as, for, empoweredBy
LegalSystemMod — The element legalSystemMod is a metadata element specifying an (active or passive) modification in the legal system for the document. Properties: uri, type

Legislature — The element legislature is an inline element within preface to identify the string used by the document for the legislature relative to the document. Use #refersTo to a TLCEvent to refer to the event of the specific legislature. Properties: uri, value
Level — This element is a hierarchical container called "level" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Lifecycle — The lifecycle element of an Akoma Ntoso document. Properties: uri, source
List — This element is a hierarchical container called "list" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Location — The element location is an inline element to identify a text fragment introducing or referring to a location in the ontology. Properties: uri, refersTo
LongTitle — The element longTitle is the section of the preface or coverPage that is called long title. Properties: uri
MainBody — The element mainBody is the container of the main part of all other document types. Properties: uri

Mapping — The element mapping contains a reference to the permanent wId (attribute original) of a structure, and to the eId (attribute current) such structure had during the time interval included between an initial temporalGroup and a final temporalGroup. This is useful for tracking the evolving ids of documents frequently renumbered (e,g., bills). Every single element whose wId does not match its eId needs to be represented here. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, original, current, start, end
Mappings — The mappings element of an Akoma Ntoso document. Properties: uri, source
MeaningMod — The element meaningMod is a metadata element specifying an (active or passive) modification in meaning for the document. Properties: uri, type
Meta — The meta element of an Akoma Ntoso document. Properties: uri
MinisterialStatements — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that contain written statements by participants. Properties: uri
Mmod — The element mmod is an inline element containing multiple specifications of modifications on another document. Properties: uri, for
Mod — The element mod is an inline element containing the specification of a modification on another document. Properties: uri, for

Modification — The complex type modificationType lists all the properties associated to modification elements. A label carried by EfficacyMod, ForceMod, LegalSystemMod, MeaningMod, ScopeMod and TextualMod. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, period, status, exclusion, incomplete, refersTo
Motivation — This element is a structural container for the section of a judgment containing the motivation. Properties: uri
Mref — The element mref is an inline element containing multiple references (each in turn represented by a ref element). Properties: uri
NationalInterest — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that contain resolutions. Properties: uri
NeutralCitation — The element neutralCitation is an inline element within judgments to identify the string declared by the document as being the neutral citation for the judgment. Properties: uri

New — The element new is a metadata element containing (in some non-managed form) the new text of the modification. Attribute href points to the eId of the element old it is substituting. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href
Note — The element note is a metadata element containing the text of the footnote and endnote specified. Properties: uri, marker, placement, placementBase
NoteRef — The element noteRef is a reference to a editorial note placed in the notes metadata section. Properties: uri, marker, placement, placementBase, href
Notes — The notes element of an Akoma Ntoso document. Properties: uri, source, lang
NoticesOfMotion — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that are relevant to the notices of motions. Properties: uri
Object — The element object is is an inline element to identify a text fragment introducing or referring to an object in the ontology. Properties: uri, refersTo
OfficialGazette — Element officialGazette is used for describing the structure and content of an issue of an official gazette. Properties: uri, name, contains

Old — The element old is a metadata element containing (in some non-managed form) the old text of the modification. Attribute href points to the eId of the element new it is being substituted by. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href
Opinion — The element opinion is an inline element to identify where the document defines the opinion of an actor. Properties: uri, by, type
OralStatements — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that contain oral statements by participants. Properties: uri
Organization — The element organization is an inline element to identify a text fragment introducing or referring to an organization in the ontology. Properties: uri, refersTo
Original — The element original is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of the original version of this document (i.e., the first expression). Properties: uri

OtherAnalysis — The element otherAnalysis is a metadata container of any additional metadata analysis element that does not belong to the specific categories provided before. Anything can be placed in this element.. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, source
OtherReferences — The otherReferences element of an Akoma Ntoso document. Properties: uri, source
Overrules — The element overrules is a metadata element specifying a reference to a source overruled by the argument being described. Properties: uri
Papers — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that are relevant to the display of papers. Properties: uri
Paragraph — This element is a hierarchical container called "paragraph" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Parliamentary — The element parliamentary is a metadata container of the analysis of the events of a debate. Properties: uri
Part — This element is a hierarchical container called "part" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Party — The element party is an inline element within judgments to identify where the document defines one of the parties. Properties: uri, refersTo, as
PassiveModifications — The element passiveModifications is a metadata container of the passive modifications affecting the document. Properties: uri
PassiveRef — The element passiveRef is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of a document providing modifications on this document (i.e., a passive references). Properties: uri

Period — The complex type periodType defines the empty content model and the list of attributes for metadata elements in the analysis section using periods. A label carried by Application, Duration, Efficacy and Force. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, period

Person — The element person is an inline element to identify a text fragment introducing or referring to a person in the ontology. Attribute as allows to specify a TLCrole the person is holding in the context of the document's mention. Properties: uri, refersTo, as
PersonalStatements — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that contain written statements by participants. Properties: uri
Petitions — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that are relevant to petitions. Properties: uri
Point — This element is a hierarchical container called "point" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
PointOfOrder — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that are relevant to points of order. Properties: uri
Portion — Element portion is used for describing the structure and content of an independent portion of a document. Properties: uri, includedIn
PortionBody — The element portionBody is the container of a portion of another document. Properties: uri
Prayers — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that contain prayers. Properties: uri
Preamble — The element preamble is used as a container of the text that opens the main body of the document as a preamble. Properties: uri
Preface — The element preface is used as a container of all prefacing material (e.g. headers, formulas, etc.). Properties: uri

Presentation — The element presentation is a metadata container of any presentation specification for the visual rendering of Akoam Ntoso elements. Anything can be placed in this element. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, source

Previous — The element previous is a metadata element referring to the element (rather than the text) of the modification in the previous version of the document. This is especially useful when renumbering occurs, so as to specify the eId of the instance that was modified in the previous version. Attribute href points to the eId of the element being modified in the old version, using a full expression-level URI. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href
ProceduralMotions — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that are relevant to procedural motions. Properties: uri
Process — The element process is an inline element to identify a text fragment introducing or referring to a process in the ontology. Properties: uri, refersTo

Proprietary — The element proprietary is a metadata container of any additional metadata property that does not belong to the Akoma Ntoso properties. Anything can be placed in this element. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, source
Proviso — This element is a hierarchical container called "proviso" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri

Publication — The element publication is the metadata container specifying an official publication event for the FRBR expression of the document. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, date, showAs, shortForm, name, number, refersTo
PutsInQuestion — The element putsInQuestions is a metadata element specifying a reference to a source questioned by the argument being described. Properties: uri

Quantity — The element quantity is an inline element to identify a text fragment introducing or referring to a quantity. This could be a dimensionless number, or a number referring to a length, weight, duration, etc. or even a sum of money. The attribute normalized contains the value normalized in a number, if appropriate. Properties: uri, refersTo, normalized
Question — The element question is a container of a single official question as proposed by an MP to a person holding an official position. Properties: uri
Questions — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that are relevant to questions. Properties: uri
Quorum — The element quorum is a metadata container containing the value of a quorum in a vote or a quorum verification. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, value, refersTo, href

QuorumVerification — The element quorumVerification is a metadata container containing information about an event of quorum verification happened within a debate. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, outcome, refersTo, href

QuotedStructure — The element quotedStructure is a subFlow element containing a full structure proposed as an insertion or a replacement. Attribute quote is used to specify the quote character used in the original; no quote attribute implies that the quote is left in the text; quote="" implies that there is no quote character. Attribute for is used in a mmod or rmod to point to the eId of the corresponding ref element. Properties: uri, startQuote, endQuote, inlineQuote, for

QuotedText — The element quotedText is an inline element containing a small string that is used either as the text being replaced, or the replacement, or the positioning at which some modification should take place. Attribute quote is used to specify the quote character used in the original; no quote attribute implies that the quote is left in the text; quote="" implies that there is no quote character. Attribute for is used to point to the eId of the corresponding ref element. Properties: uri, startQuote, endQuote, inlineQuote, for
Recital — The element recital is the individual element of the preface that is called recital. Properties: uri, num, heading, subheading
Recitals — The element recitals is the section of the preamble that contains recitals. Properties: uri, num, heading, subheading
Recount — The element recount is a metadata container containing information about an event of a recount happened within a debate. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, outcome, refersTo, href
Ref — The element ref is an inline element containing a legal reference. Properties: uri, href

RefItem — An entry of the references section: a top-level class of the Akoma Ntoso ontology (a TLC), or a reference to another document (a DocRef). It is what the refersTo attribute of an element points at, and what the references element contains. A label carried by ActiveRef, AttachmentOf, HasAttachment, Jurisprudence, Original, PassiveRef, TLCConcept, TLCEvent, TLCLocation, TLCObject, TLCOrganization, TLCPerson, TLCProcess, TLCReference, TLCRole and TLCTerm. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, showAs, shortForm

References — The element references is a metadata container of all the references to entities external to the document mentioned in the document. They include references to legal documents of any form,a s well as references to people, organizations, events, roles, concepts, and anything else is managed by the Akoma Ntoso ontology. Properties: uri, source
RelatedDocument — The element relatedDocument is an inline element to identify the document for which this document is a report of. Properties: uri, href
Remedies — This element is a structural container for the section of a judgment containing the remedies. Properties: uri
Resolutions — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that contain resolutions. Properties: uri

Restriction — The element restriction specifies information about a restriction (such as a jurisdiction specification) by pointing to a specific legislative, geographic or temporal events through the refersTo attribute. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, refersTo, type
Restrictions — The restrictions element of an Akoma Ntoso document. Properties: uri, source
Restricts — The element restricts is a metadata element specifying a reference to a source restricted by the argument being described. Properties: uri
Result — The element result is a metadata element specifying the overall result of the judgment. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, type
Rmod — The element rmod is an inline element containing the specification of a range of modifications on another document. Properties: uri, for, from, upTo
Role — The element role is an inline element to identify a text fragment introducing or referring to a role in the ontology. Properties: uri, refersTo
RollCall — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that contain a roll call of individuals. Properties: uri
Rref — The element rref is an inline element containing a range of references between the IRI specified in the from attribute and the one specified in the upTo attribute. Properties: uri, from, upTo
Rule — This element is a hierarchical container called "rule" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
ScopeMod — The element scopeMod is a metadata element specifying an (active or passive) modification in scope for the document. Properties: uri, type
Section — This element is a hierarchical container called "section" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri

SemanticInline — The group ANsemanticInline lists additional elements that are inline, and are specific to the Akoma Ntoso vocabulary. A label carried by Concept, Date, Def, Entity, Event, Location, Object, Organization, Person, Process, Quantity, Role, Term and Time. Properties: uri

Session — The element session is an inline element within preface to identify the string used by the document for the session of the legislature relative to the document. Use #refersTo to a TLCEvent to refer to the event of the specific session. Properties: uri, value
ShortTitle — The element shortTitle is an inline element within preface to identify the string used by the document for the short title of the document. Properties: uri
Signature — The element signature is an inline element within conclusions to identify where the document defines one of the signatures. Properties: uri
Source — The element source is a metadata element specifying the IRI of the source of the modification. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, pos, exclusion, incomplete, upTo
Speech — The element speech is a container of a single speech utterance in a debate. Dialogs between speakers need a speech element each. Properties: uri

SpeechGroup — The element speechGroup is a container of speech elements. This element is meant to pooint out, in a complex sequence of individual speech elements, the main contributor, i.e., the individual speech who was introducedand expected and that is causing the complex sequence that follows. Attributes by, as and to are those of the main speech. Properties: uri

SpeechSection — The group speechSection lists the structures that should contain speeches. A label carried by Address, Adjournment, AdministrationOfOath, Communication, DebateSection, DeclarationOfVote, MinisterialStatements, NationalInterest, NoticesOfMotion, OralStatements, Papers, PersonalStatements, Petitions, PointOfOrder, Prayers, ProceduralMotions, Questions, Resolutions, RollCall and WrittenStatements. Properties: uri, num, heading, subheading

Statement — Element statement is used for describing the structure and content of an official document of a body that may or may not be normative in structure (e.g., statements, resolutions, etc.). Properties: uri, name, contains

Step — The element step is a metadata element specifying facts about a workflow step occurred to the document. For each event, a date, a type, an agent (and the corresponding role) that generated the action must be referenced. The outcome, too, can be specified. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, href, date, by, as, refersTo, outcome

SubFlow — The type subFlowStructure specifies the overall content model of the elements that are subFlows. A label carried by AuthorialNote, Note and QuotedStructure. Properties: uri, heading, subheading, num
Subchapter — This element is a hierarchical container called "subchapter" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Subclause — This element is a hierarchical container called "subclause" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Subdivision — This element is a hierarchical container called "subdivision" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Sublist — This element is a hierarchical container called "sublist" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Subparagraph — This element is a hierarchical container called "subparagraph" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Subpart — This element is a hierarchical container called "subpart" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Subrule — This element is a hierarchical container called "subrule" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Subsection — This element is a hierarchical container called "subsection" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Subtitle — This element is a hierarchical container called "subtitle" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Supports — The element supports is a metadata element specifying a reference to a source supported by the argument being described. Properties: uri

TLC — The group TLCs is a list of types of Top Level classes of the Akoma Ntoso ontology. A label carried by TLCConcept, TLCEvent, TLCLocation, TLCObject, TLCOrganization, TLCPerson, TLCProcess, TLCReference, TLCRole and TLCTerm. Properties: uri
TLCConcept — The element TLCConcept is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of an ontology instance of the class Concept. Properties: uri
TLCEvent — The element TLCEvent is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of an ontology instance of the class Event. Properties: uri
TLCLocation — The element TLCLocation is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of an ontology instance of the class Location. Properties: uri
TLCObject — The element TLCObject is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of an ontology instance of the class Object. Properties: uri
TLCOrganization — The element TLCOrganization is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of an ontology instance of the class Organization. Properties: uri
TLCPerson — The element TLCPerson is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of an ontology instance of the class Person. Properties: uri
TLCProcess — The element TLCProcess is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of an ontology instance of the class Process. Properties: uri
TLCReference — The element TLCreference is a generic metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of an ontology instance of a class specified through the name attribute. Properties: uri, name
TLCRole — The element TLCRole is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of an ontology instance of the class Role. Properties: uri
TLCTerm — The element TLCTerm is a metadata reference to the Akoma Ntoso IRI of an ontology instance of the class Term. Properties: uri
TemporalData — The temporalData element of an Akoma Ntoso document. Properties: uri, source
TemporalGroup — The temporalGroup element of an Akoma Ntoso document. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid
Term — The element term is an inline element to identify a text fragment introducing or referring to a term in the ontology. Properties: uri, refersTo
TextualMod — The element textualMod is a metadata element specifying an (active or passive) textual modification for the document. Properties: uri, type
Time — The element time is an inline element to identify a time expressed in the text and to propose a normalized representation in the time attribute. Properties: uri, time

TimeInterval — The element timeInterval contains all the data needed to identify a specific time interval. It is built either with two dates or with a date and a duration (exactly two of the 'start', 'end' and 'duration' attributes can be specified). Values of the 'start' and 'end' attributes are NOT dates, but references to event elements in the corresponding metadata section. The refers attribute is a reference to a temporal concept belonging to the Akoma Ntoso ontology and specified in the references section. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, start, end, duration, refersTo
Title — This element is a hierarchical container called "title" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri

TitleInline — The group ANtitleInline lists the elements that are inline, are specific to the Akoma Ntoso vocabulary, and should only be used within the initial elements (preface, preamble and coverpage). A label carried by DocAuthority, DocCommittee, DocDate, DocIntroducer, DocJurisdiction, DocNumber, DocProponent, DocPurpose, DocStage, DocStatus, DocTitle, DocType, DocketNumber, Legislature, Session and ShortTitle. Properties: uri
Tome — This element is a hierarchical container called "tome" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Transitional — This element is a hierarchical container called "transitional" either explicitly or due to the local tradition. Properties: uri
Vote — The element vote is an inline that wraps either the name of the voter (when organized by choice) or the vote (when organized by name) in a voting report. Properties: uri, by, as, choice
Voting — The element voting is a metadata container containing information about an event of a vote happened within a debate. Properties: uri, eId, wId, guid, outcome, refersTo, href
Workflow — The workflow element of an Akoma Ntoso document. Properties: uri, source
WrapUp — The element wrapUp is a concluding element in a hierarchy that contains paragraphs wrapping up the preceding lower hierarchical elements. Properties: uri
WrittenStatements — This element is a structural container for parts of a debates that contain written statements by participants. Properties: uri
